evidenceKind: primary-source documentation review, local parser audit, and generated fast regression
scope: Repeated coordinate component assembly in explicit 2D/3D entity readers
Nested HATCH/MLEADER framing and repeated MLINE vectors
Implementation-ready follow-up probes and evidence limits

observations.ordering: Entity readers must not assume the code-table/display order; order can change under conditions or in future releases.
observations.framing: Group code 0 begins the next entity or ends the section; table advice does not authorize global tag sorting.
observations.forwardCompatibility: The reference recommends dispatching by group code and ignoring undefined codes where appropriate.
observations.hatch: Spline boundary points are repeated per-component arrays inside a count-framed edge; weights and tangents are separate fields.
observations.mleader: The same point group codes are reused across context, leader-node, and leader-line scopes; local permutations must not cross those scopes.
observations.mline: Vertex positions, segment direction vectors, and miter vectors are three repeated per-vertex vector arrays, with nested 74/41 and 75/42 parameter sequences.

sources.limitation: DXF entity references do not define DWG bit layouts or ACIS semantics.

sources.revision: Mutable master source links; no checkout or execution

observations.ezdxf: Entity loading creates a subclass processor and dispatches into DXF attribute loaders.
observations.acadsharp: Entity properties declare DXF group codes through attribute metadata.

sources.limitation: Source architecture is context, not proof that either peer handles every valid permutation; neither peer was pinned or run.

observations.model: The peer exposes structured MLeaderContext, LeaderData, LeaderLine, vertex, and break models; it documents leader vertices as WCS coordinates.
observations.risk: Its internals explicitly describe MLeader context as complex nested data beyond simple tags, supporting a narrowly scoped context-state probe rather than global tag sorting.

sources.limitation: Documentation is not an executed differential test and does not prove broad semantic parity.

confirmedAndFixed.failureShape: Control/fit points were created only on X groups, making earlier Y/Z groups disappear or misassociate.
confirmedAndFixed.correction: Independent X/Y/Z occurrence cursors assemble point slots by per-component ordinal while retaining same-code order and count/cap validation.
generatedCoverage: Y/Z component groups before X groups

confirmedAndFixed.failureShape: A legal generated vertex with Y/Z components before X was rejected before the MESH callback.
confirmedAndFixed.correction: Reused phase-counter slots as bounded per-axis occurrence ordinals during vertex parsing while preserving face/edge/crease sections and counts.

confirmedAndFixed.failureShape: Grouped coordinate and per-vertex optional-field arrays lost or misbound values when Y/optional arrays preceded their X slot.
confirmedAndFixed.correction: Bound each supported per-vertex group to its own occurrence ordinal under declared counts and caps.

confirmedAndFixed.failureShape: Y/Z arrays preceding X were discarded because points were created only by X groups.
confirmedAndFixed.correction: Use independent bounded 10/20/30 occurrence ordinals while preserving advisory group-76 behavior.

confirmedAndFixed.failureShape: Y-before-X control and fit arrays lost association or were rejected in generated ASCII/Binary DXF.
confirmedAndFixed.correction: Use bounded control-X/Y and fit-X/Y ordinals inside the current spline edge; preserve ordinary HATCH pair transition and nested counts/framing.
